summary: 21-year-old climber separated from partner Brandon Wilhelm near the Knife Edge on Capitol Peaks descent and took a direct line toward the lake over a cliff band; found next day with fatal fall injuries (600-700 ft fall); recovered by MRA, flown by Flight for Life to Pitkin County Airport.
location: cliff band below the Knife Edge, Capitol Peak
notes: Source: Mountain Rescue Aspen Facebook page. Date approximate. Fifth fatality on Capitol Peak in 2017 per post.
